split_unit: geometry_id, not individual points or trajectory samples

leakage_policy.same_geometry_across_roles: forbidden unless an explicitly versioned exception is approved before preprocessing
leakage_policy.grouping_key: canonical geometry_id derived from source geometry hash
leakage_policy.split_manifest: immutable before training/tuning and included in experiment identity
leakage_policy.duplicate_detection: compare canonical geometry hashes and declared parent/source IDs
leakage_policy.near_duplicate_policy: must be flagged for review; cannot silently cross train/test
leakage_policy.random_seed: recorded even when geometry-level stratification is deterministic

empty_dataset_policy: H1 may freeze this schema and policy with zero Stage 3 geometry records; it must not fabricate a formal dataset.
provenance: attached Stage 3 H1 request: geometry-level leakage prevention
